count_semantics: fresh logical st_size per regular pathname, including each regular-target file symlink; hardlink multiplicity retained; directory links not enumerated; no contents read/cache/inventory exclusions
overflow_semantics: stop as soon as observed lower bound exceeds ceiling, reject; accepted scans visit all three scope populations
races: same mutable-snapshot additions/deletions limitations as existing resource scanner; O_NOFOLLOW directory opens prevent replacement-link traversal; no atomic snapshot or hostile writer guarantee
performance_claim: None. Lead profiles actual old/new full scans and charges all scan CPU/wall to each future arm. Existing budget-rejected ArcDice result remains rejected.
missing_scope_semantics: Only an initially absent top-level scope counts zero; FileNotFoundError during an existing-root scan rejects, never discards accumulated scope evidence.
